quote: For a conscious being, to exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
source: Henri Bergson, Creative Evolution, ch. I, p. 7 (trans. Arthur Mitchell, 1911)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg #26163, Creative Evolution, authorized translation by Arthur Mitchell, Henry Holt and Company, 1911; the HTML edition places the sentence between its page 7 and page 8 markers
evidence.locator: Chapter I, The Evolution of Life, p. 7

reason: Mitchell’s sentence reads “we find that, for a conscious being, to exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly”, on p. 7 of the 1911 Holt edition; the quotation lifts the clause verbatim.
